rules.heuristic: In verified macro bull regimes (Price > 200 EMA & Fast > Slow EMA), scale leverage to 1.8x-2.8x. In bear regimes, immediately de-leverage to 0.0x (100% Cash).
Low-beta mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, LLY) do not crash into RSI < 35 oversold territory during bull runs; use mild 12/16-day EMA pullback tolerance (1.5-4.5%) to eliminate cash drag.
When FinBERT news sentiment drops below -0.50 on material regulatory/earnings headlines, liquidate immediately without waiting for moving average technical breakdown (saves +28% drawdown).
For block orders > $250,000, execute via closed-form hyperbolic Almgren-Chriss slicing to minimize temporary and permanent market impact shortfall.
Once a position gains +1.5x ATR, move stop-loss to entry price + 0.5x ATR; continuously lock 65-80% of peak gains as the trade trends upward.
After closing any position on MODEL_SELL or STOP_LOSS, enforce a strict 72-hour quarantine embargo [t_exit, t_exit + 3 days]. Prevents ping-pong wash-sales and frictional whipsaw churn.
Limit open portfolio allocation to max 1 asset per GICS sector. Prevents simultaneous multi-asset failure cascades (e.g. holding 8 industrial stocks concurrently).

For winning trades, enforce escalating multi-tier ratchets: +1% locked at +3% gain, +2.5% locked at +5% gain, +5% locked at +8% gain. Bank 50% at TP1 (+2.5 ATR), and trail runner stop at max(P_entry * 1.02, P_max * 0.965).

Require at least 3 out of 5 specialist buy votes and >= 58.0% effective conviction to execute an entry. For assets with recent stop-outs or sector caution, demand Super-Majority (>= 3/5 votes and >= 65% conviction).
When market-wide VIX > 24.0 or VPIN Order Flow Toxicity triggers critical dumping signals, pause all new long allocations and preserve 100% cash dry powder.
